content.short: Sick City is collaborating with musicians to bring a thriving music scene to Cardano.
content.description: Sick City is a label and social media platform for musicians based or entering the Cardano Blockchain. Our mission is to create a positive environment for musicians and music lovers, to promote and support artists within the space by giving them a platform to share their thoughts, ideas, voice, and music to the community, to provide said artists with the tools to be successful in the Cardano community, and to give the members of the Cardano Community a music experience that they’ve never had before.
content.meta: Find out about Sick City (MUSIC) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
